name: Keyless command-line provider
description: Drives the local Claude command-line tool in print mode so planning and answering run on the operator's subscription login. Planning asks for only the decision JSON and parses leniently, and the spawned process has API credentials stripped from its environment.
advantages: No API key and no per-token billing, so a whole runner can operate on a subscription alone.
disadvantages: Spawning a process adds latency, the tool cannot force a tool choice, and tiers are limited to the model families the tool can run.

name: MCP gateway bridge transport
description: Wraps a generic MCP client to speak a small fixed set of gateway tools: long-poll for events to receive, send a message, and best-effort attachment fetch. It deliberately has no code path that responds to the gateway's own permission requests, clamps the poll timeout and tolerates key spelling drift.
advantages: Reuses a maintained gateway so many chat networks become channels without new code, and its small tool surface limits risk. Selected because: RunnerConfig.channel_transport
disadvantages: Depends on the gateway's availability and security posture and on guessed payload shapes. Only one channel family is covered.
